title: ProductionInterval
description: Available, actual and curtailed energy for one asset in one interval. DRAFT until Milestone A freeze (owners: Dev 3 + Dev 4).

interval_minutes.description: DK1 day-ahead is 15-minute since 1 Oct 2025; POC fixtures use 15.

curtailed_mwh.description: Optional. If absent, the calc derives max(available - actual, 0).

mwh.description: Non-negative MWh as decimal string with 3 decimals.
